meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一个选题,变成图文并茂的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿或选题,想快速做成能直接发布的解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or topic into a graphics-and-text explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a script or topic and want a publishable explainer video fast

howto.what: 把一段文字（文章、笔记、话题或简介）逐帧做成无出镜解说视频：画面不靠拍摄，而是每幕自创排版、抽象图形、示意图和数据可视化。产出分镜、脚本、配音与最终视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提供一段文章、笔记或话题，要做概念讲解、操作教程或清单类解说视频时接管。做基于网站的视频或用途不明时不走它。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一段无出镜解说视频。
say.note: 会先确认简报再建项目

say.text: 用这个主题做一条 60 秒的清单类解说视频，男声配音。
say.note: 会按指定音色生成旁白

say.text: 跳过草图，直接按分镜开始逐帧制作。
say.note: 分镜通过后进入逐帧搭建

howto.what_en: Turns a body of text into a faceless explainer video, inventing each scene's visuals as typography, graphics, diagrams, and data-viz. Outputs a storyboard, script, audio, and final video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand over an article, notes, or a topic and want a concept explainer, how-to, or listicle video. Website-based videos or unclear intent route elsewhere.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It confirms the brief and creates the project.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second listicle explainer on this topic with a male voice.
say_en.note: It generates narration with that voice.

say_en.text: Skip the sketches and start building the frames from the storyboard.
say_en.note: Frames get built once the storyboard is approved.
